title: Collections
description: Dictionaries, indexing, slices, sorting, and Go-inspired list helpers.
source:
# Dictionaries, indexing, slices, sorting, and Go-inspired list helpers.
फल := {"सेब": 3, "केला": 5, "आम": 2}
प्रत्येक नाम मध्ये फल:
    मुद्रय(नाम, "=", फल[नाम])

संख्या := [4, 1, 9, 2]
मुद्रय("क्रमबद्ध:", क्रम(संख्या))
मुद्रय("पहली दो:", संख्या[:2])
मुद्रय("योग:", योग(संख्या))

स्थान := बनाओ("सूची", 2)
प्रतिलिपि(स्थान, संख्या)
मुद्रय("प्रतिलिपि:", स्थान, "क्षमता:", क्षमता(स्थान))

title: Conditionals
description: A small score report: variables, Boolean conditions, and if/elif/else.
source:
# A small score report: variables, Boolean conditions, and if/elif/else.
नाम := "आर्या"
अंक := 82

यदि अंक >= 90:
    श्रेणी := "A"
अन्ययदि अंक >= 75:
    श्रेणी := "B"
अन्यथा:
    श्रेणी := "C"

मुद्रय(f"{नाम}: {अंक} अंक, श्रेणी {श्रेणी}")
मुद्रय("उत्तीर्ण:", अंक >= 40 च अंक <= 100)

description: Build a deterministic reorder list from in-memory stock and minimums.

title: Inventory Reorder
description: Build a deterministic reorder list from in-memory stock and minimums.
source:
# Build a deterministic reorder list from in-memory stock and minimums.
# A missing stock entry counts as zero units on hand.
कार्य reorder_report(stock, minimums):
    report := []
    प्रत्येक sku मध्ये क्रम(minimums):
        on_hand := stock[sku] यदि sku मध्ये stock अन्यथा 0
        needed := minimums[sku] - on_hand
        यदि needed > 0:
            report = जोड़ो(report, {"sku": sku, "quantity": needed})
    प्रत्यावर्तय report

stock := {"A-100": 4, "B-200": 12}
minimums := {"A-100": 10, "B-200": 8, "C-300": 5}
reorders := reorder_report(stock, minimums)

प्रत्येक row मध्ये reorders:
    मुद्रय(row["sku"], "reorder", row["quantity"])
मुद्रय("Reorder lines:", लम्बाई(reorders))

title: Invoice Cents
description: Calculate an invoice in integer cents to avoid rounding in money totals.
source:
# Calculate an invoice in integer cents to avoid rounding in money totals.
# Return None for invalid quantities, prices, or discounts.
कार्य invoice_total_cents(lines, discount_cents):
    subtotal := 0
    प्रत्येक line मध्ये lines:
        यदि line["quantity"] < 0 वा line["unit_cents"] < 0:
            प्रत्यावर्तय शून्यम्
        subtotal += line["quantity"] * line["unit_cents"]
    यदि discount_cents < 0 वा discount_cents > subtotal:
        प्रत्यावर्तय शून्यम्
    प्रत्यावर्तय subtotal - discount_cents

lines := [
    {"sku": "NOTEBOOK", "quantity": 3, "unit_cents": 1299},
    {"sku": "PEN", "quantity": 5, "unit_cents": 175},
]
total := invoice_total_cents(lines, 250)
यदि total is शून्यम्:
    मुद्रय("Invalid invoice")
अन्यथा:
    मुद्रय("Invoice total (cents):", total)

title: Service Health
description: Report service availability in basis points (10000 = 100.00%).
source:
# Report service availability in basis points (10000 = 100.00%).
# Invalid or empty samples are reported separately from unhealthy services.
कार्य availability_bps(healthy, total):
    यदि total <= 0 वा healthy < 0 वा healthy > total:
        प्रत्यावर्तय शून्यम्
    प्रत्यावर्तय healthy * 10000 // total

samples := [
    {"service": "api", "healthy": 998, "total": 1000},
    {"service": "worker", "healthy": 970, "total": 1000},
    {"service": "scheduler", "healthy": 0, "total": 0},
]

प्रत्येक sample मध्ये samples:
    score := availability_bps(sample["healthy"], sample["total"])
    यदि score is शून्यम्:
        मुद्रय(sample["service"], "no valid sample")
    अन्ययदि score < 9950:
        मुद्रय(sample["service"], "alert", score, "bps")
    अन्यथा:
        मुद्रय(sample["service"], "healthy", score, "bps")

title: Demo
description: Sanskrit keywords with Go-style := declarations and Python-style indentation.
source:
# Sanskrit keywords with Go-style := declarations and Python-style indentation.
संख्या := [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
मुद्रय("मूल सूची:", संख्या)
मुद्रय("योग:", योग(संख्या))

कार्य वर्ग(n):
    प्रत्यावर्तय n * n

वर्गाः := []
प्रत्येक n मध्ये संख्या:
    वर्गाः = जोड़ो(वर्गाः, वर्ग(n))

यदि योग(वर्गाः) > 50:
    मुद्रय("वर्गों का योग 50 से अधिक है:", वर्गाः)
अन्यथा:
    मुद्रय("वर्ग:", वर्गाः)

# Go-inspired make, append, cap, copy.
स्थान := बनाओ("सूची", 3)
प्रतिलिपि(स्थान, वर्गाः)
मुद्रय("पहले तीन:", स्थान, "क्षमता:", क्षमता(स्थान))

title: English Syntax
description: English spellings work alongside Sanskrit words and Go-style :=.
source:
# English spellings work alongside Sanskrit words and Go-style :=.
func square(n):
    return n * n

values := []
for n in range(1, 5):
    values = append(values, square(n))

print("Squares:", values)
print("Sum:", sum(values))

title: Fibonacci
description: Functions, a while loop, tuple assignment, and list building.
source:
# Functions, a while loop, tuple assignment, and list building.
कार्य फिबोनाची(कितने):
    परिणाम := []
    अ := 0
    ब := 1
    यावत् लम्बाई(परिणाम) < कितने:
        परिणाम = जोड़ो(परिणाम, अ)
        अ, ब = ब, अ + ब
    प्रत्यावर्तय परिणाम

मुद्रय("पहली आठ संख्याएँ:", फिबोनाची(8))
